name: 强化学习
description: MDP、价值/策略、时序差分、策略梯度、探索与离线学习；与控制和运筹交叉。

sources.title: UCL Course on Reinforcement Learning (David Silver) — 10 lectures, slides, videos, Easy21 assignment
sources.covers: Lecture 1–2: RL problem and MDPs (returns, value functions, Bellman equations, optimal policies); 3: planning by dynamic programming; 4–5: model-free prediction and control (TD(0), TD(λ), SARSA, Q-learning, importance sampling); 6: value function approximation incl. DQN; 7: policy gradient (REINFORCE, actor-critic); 8: integrating learning and planning (Dyna, MCTS); 9: exploration vs exploitation (ε-greedy, UCB, Thompson sampling); 10: case study.
sources.access: Slides and lecture videos public under CC BY-NC 4.0; the Easy21 assignment is described on the site. Offline/batch RL and OR/control intersections are only mentioned in passing.

evidence.location: Course page: lecture list 1–10 and materials
evidence.finding: The teaching page lists the ten lectures with slides/videos and the Easy21 assignment, covering MDPs, DP, model-free control, approximation, policy gradient, planning and exploration.

sources.title: 《动手学强化学习》（张伟楠、沈键等，上海交大）— 免费中文教材 + notebook + 视频
sources.covers: 中文正文按基础篇（多臂老虎机、MDP、动态规划、时序差分、Dyna-Q）、进阶篇（价值函数近似、DQN、策略梯度、Actor-Critic、DDPG、PPO、SAC）、前沿篇（模仿学习、离线强化学习、多智能体强化学习等）组织，每章配可在线运行的 Jupyter Notebook；官网写明配套视频课在伯禹平台免费开放。
sources.access: 在线正文、notebook 与视频课免费；纸书在京东/当当另售（不作为必需）。
sources.publisher: 上海交通大学 张伟楠等 / 伯禹学习平台

evidence.location: 首页三段式介绍与「视频课程」入口
evidence.finding: 首页写明全书分基础篇、进阶篇、前沿篇，每章配 Jupyter Notebook，并称张伟楠老师的强化学习网课视频已在伯禹学习平台完全免费开放。

sources.title: Berkeley CS 185/285 Deep Reinforcement Learning (Sergey Levine, Spring 2026) — Lectures 17–19 & 23 (Offline RL, Exploration) + Homework 5
sources.covers: 探索与离线学习：Lecture 17/18 Offline RL Part 1–2（离线 RL 的定义、on-policy/off-policy/offline 的区别、分布偏移与保守价值估计）、Lecture 19 Exploration（exploration-exploitation 的两种定义、如何发现需要长序列才得奖励的策略）、Lecture 23 Advanced Exploration；配套 Discussion Section 9 (Offline RL) 与 Homework 5: Offline RL。
sources.access: 课程站点公开全部 slides 与作业（免费）；2026 春季课程录像需按站点链接（Fall 2023 recordings 公开）。仅核对 slides，视频是否公开可播未逐条核对。
sources.publisher: UC Berkeley RAIL Lab / Sergey Levine

evidence.location: lec-17.pdf 封面 “Offline Reinforcement Learning / CS 185/285 / Instructor: Sergey Levine”，第 3 页对比 on-policy / off-policy / offline RL；lec-19.pdf 封面 “Exploration”，第 7 页讲 exploration-exploitation 与长序列奖励发现
evidence.finding: 两份 slides 正文确实按主题展开（离线 RL 的设定与原因、探索问题的两种定义），课程页同时列出 Homework 5 与 Section 9，能支撑“探索与离线学习”。

topics.note: 组合项：探索英文完整，离线 RL 只有中文教材的前沿篇成章；英文侧 partial。；Silver 课程只在 Lec 9 讲 ε-greedy/乐观初始化这类探索，没有离线 RL；r7-en1 用两讲离线 RL（分布偏移、保守价值估计、为什么不能直接离线 Q-learning）加作业，再用两讲探索（定义、乐观/后验采样类方法、长序列探索）补齐，所以这个合并知识点在英文侧完整。

steps.read: 基础篇：MDP→动态规划→时序差分→Dyna-Q，逐章跑 notebook；进阶篇：价值近似→DQN→策略梯度→Actor-Critic→PPO；前沿篇读离线强化学习。
Watch lectures 1–9 in order and do Easy21; implement TD(0), SARSA/Q-learning, DQN and REINFORCE.

After Silver's course, watch/read CS285 Lectures 17–18 on offline RL and do Homework 5 (train an offline agent and compare with a naive off-policy baseline to see distribution shift), then Lectures 19 and 23 on exploration and implement an optimistic or count-based bonus.
